datasets.description: Afghanistan Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/afghanistan_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Afghanistan to classify geographic areas by IPC acute food insecurity phase. Classifications were aggregated into medium-term projections for 2021, with multiple scenarios represented. Data was collected at sub-national administrative levels and distributed as geographic features with classification metadata.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications reflect acute food insecurity outcomes driven by multiple hazards including drought, conflict, and economic shocks.
